The resort is located in Breckenridge, Colorado at the base of peak 9, just two blocks from Main street. The town of Breckenridge is 1 1/2 hours West of Denver, Colorado. It features spacious one and two bedroom suites, each with a gas fireplace and fully equipped kitchen.

Two large outdoor whirlpool spas are just steps from the Spa and Fitness Center. A game room for children, a relaxing sauna, and a host of other activities await guests.

Situated in Breckenridge, this apartment hotel is a condominium property, set close to the Edwin Carter Museum, Breckenridge Ski Resort and the Barney Ford House Museum. Each condominium also features a kitchen with a refrigerator, stove-top hob, microwave and cooking equipment/crockery/utensils. Coffee/tea makers and clock radios are also included. Additional features include individually regulated air conditioning and individually regulated heating. All guest rooms are non-smoking.

The hotel offers on-site indoor hot tubs and a sauna. Breckenridge Golf Club can be found approximately 8 km away (fees apply).

Description:
Near Barney Ford House Museum and Edwin Carter Museum, this Breckenridge condominium resort is situated on a river. Additional nearby points of interest include Breckenridge Ski Resort. This charming European-style lodge is located directly across the street from the Four O' Clock Ski Run. The hotel has easy access to the free county-wide transportation and local trolley service.

This condominium provides luxury with hotel extras. It is cosy and congenial, warm, and friendly. This charming European-style lodge offers convenience along with everything else guests are looking for in a resort. The lodge has a 24-hour front desk featuring 24-hour check-out service and a hotel safe, a ski and snowboard rental and repair shop, a fireside lounge, meeting rooms, and much more such as a bar and a restaurant. There are 80 guest rooms at this ski hotel, with lift access to the upper floors provided. The hotel also has a car park.

The lodge has 80 guest rooms with double beds and all have a TV with cable channels and VCRs. Telephones with free local calls and complimentary weekday newspapers, coffee/tea makers, an ironing set, climate control and clock radios are provided. The en suite bathrooms include a shower, bath, hairdryer and complimentary toiletries. Amenities available on request include wake-up calls.

The hotel has an outdoor seasonal swimming pool, sun loungers, a gym and ski storage. For an additional fee, guests can play golf or go biking.

The hotel has a restaurant on site offering breakfast, lunch and dinner.

From Denver International Airport. Head north. Take the ramp onto Peña Boulevard. Merge onto I-70 W. Take exit 203 for CO-9 S towards Frisco/Breckenridge. Description: If you're looking for romance or a secluded get a way, this private cabin is the place for you! Beautiful aspen trees and stunning Colorado mountain views will surround you in this fantastic custom built log home sitting on three acres. The cabin is easily accessible as a winter or summer vacation rental since the county maintains the roads throughout the ski season, making the road an easy drive to the cabin in the winter and summer months. Many find this unique two bedroom three bath home in Fraser, Colorado, just the perfect lodging spot for a private getaway or their honeymoon retreat! The private cabin will sleep up to six people with a queen bed in each bedroom and a queen sofa sleeper in the walkout lower level; this level also has a private bathroom. The owners have put their own personal touches in this home including two satellite TVs, a hot tub on the large back deck and a gas grill. The western inspired decor is elegant yet comfortable, just what you would expect in a Colorado mountain home. The two best features of this cabin: Views of Byers Peak, the meadow and the Fraser Valley are inspiring (the reason for its name) and second, the tranquility of being four miles from Hwy 40 while still being close to the towns of Fraser and Winter Park make it the ideal vacation rental off the beaten track.
